info.name: Purdue.io Course Catalog Buildings Rooms API

description.content:
A community-built, public OData v4 REST API exposing Purdue University's course catalog data, including Campuses, Buildings, Rooms, Terms, Courses, Classes, Sections, Meetings, Subjects and Instructors. This OpenAPI 3.0 description was converted faithfully from the live OData v4 $metadata (EDMX 4.0) document at https://api.purdue.io/odata/$metadata and verified against live responses. Entities are queryable via standard OData system query options. Note: the live service disables the $top option (limit 0); use $skip with server-driven paging instead.
